items.text:
a) Explain the following sampling methods i) Quota ii) Simple random iii) Stratified (6 Marks)
b) With the aid of sketches differentiate between the following terms as used in statistics i) Positive and negative skew ii) Positive and negative correlation (6 Marks)
c) A random sample of 12 components has a mean weight of 50 gm and standard deviation of 9 gm. Determine the population mean with a 95% confidence. (4 Marks)
d) 10 % of components produced by a machine are defective. Determine the probability that in a random sample of 8 components at most two will be defective. (4 Marks)
